title: Scenario
description: A simulated run of one site: what happens when, and what must then be true. Lives in <site>/scenarios/. Times are durations from the start of the run (30m, 6h, 2d) and must fall on a tick.

share.description: Over a time window: the share of ticks that must be inside the range (default: all of them)

site.description: Optional. Must be the id of the site whose folder holds this file

environment.description: Laid over the site's sim.yaml: only what this scenario needs different (ambient, reservoirs, zones, seed)

do.description: Something done to the simulated world

command.description: A hub command, sent as an operator would send it. Its other fields are the command's arguments

refused.description: With command: the hub is expected to refuse it

result.description: With command: fields the hub's result must have

items.description: One thing that must be true. When: `at` a moment, `by` a moment (at some tick up to it), or during a window (`from`, `to`; default the whole run). What: one check of a zone, device, strip, planting or of the hub's events.

status.description: The zone's status, as on its LED segment

active.description: Statuses that are all active in the zone, whichever is shown

active_is.description: Exactly these statuses are active, no others

led_sequence.description: Every status the zone's segment has shown up to then, in order, without repeats

air_temperature.description: The simulated truth in the zone, not what a sensor reported

is_on.description: Not `on`: YAML reads that key as true

on_between.description: Over a window: on at every tick inside these local times and off outside them

on_time.description: Total time the actuator was on in the window

delivered_ml.description: Water a pump really moved: in total at a moment, or within a window

stage.description: With planting: its stage (null when finished). With zone: the stage the zone is running

event.description: Hub events of this kind, up to a moment or within a window

where.description: Only events whose fields have these values

contains.description: Only events whose text fields contain these strings

min_gap.description: The least time between two such events

rolling.description: The sum of a field over any window of this length never exceeds max

values.description: field -> the values of that field over the events, in order

offsets.description: When the events happened, from the start of the run
